jobs.title: Vendor Strategy Manager - Cisco
jobs.description:
About the Role
In this role, you will be responsible for developing and implementing strategic market and product line business plans, analyzing market data, leading vendor quarterly business reviews, and acting as the business owner for assigned vendor technology or product line. You will be seen as the go-to person for supporting vendor strategies and go-to-market plans, as well as identifying volume and strategic customers, developing partnerships, and driving market growth. As a Strategic Business Manager, you will play a critical role in uncovering new business opportunities, refining growth plans, and implementing effective marketing strategies to build awareness and sales volume.

What You’ll Do
·       Develop and implement strategic market and product line business plans and programs to drive growth and achieve business objectives.
·       Analyze market data to identify trends, opportunities, and potential areas for business expansion; create comprehensive reports and presentations.
·       Lead vendor Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), fostering collaboration and alignment with vendors to drive mutual success.
·       Act as the business owner for assigned vendor technology or product line, taking responsibility for its performance, growth, and market positioning.
·       Serve as the go-to person for supporting vendor strategies and go-to-market plans, providing expertise and guidance to cross-functional teams.
·       Identify volume and strategic customers, establish and nurture partnerships to drive business growth and market penetration.
·       Create reports and deliver group presentations at vendor and customer sites, effectively communicating business insights, proposals, and solutions.
·       Proactively develop innovative approaches to uncovering new business opportunities, staying ahead of market trends and competitor activities.
·       Track progress against annual and quarterly plans, consistently monitoring and evaluating performance to achieve market growth and incremental sales.
·       Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for vendor technologies and programs, as well as market segment technologies.
·       Possess the ability to pivot quickly against the current strategy if proven ineffective, based on ROI and results.
·       Cross-market complementary solutions into appropriate vertical segments, maximizing revenue opportunities.
·       Refine growth plans on an ongoing basis, identifying ways to build margin through bundling, introducing third-party materials, etc.
·       Identify in-demand products within the assigned product line and develop effective marketing strategies to build awareness and increase sales volume.
·       Lead and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

What We’re Looking For
·       5 to 8 years of relevant work experience.
·       College Degree in Business, IT, or related field preferred.
·       Proficient in executing instructions and requesting clarification.
·       Basic data entry and mathematical skills.
·       Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and decision-making abilities.
·       Detail-oriented with accuracy and efficiency.
·       Effective communication skills, both written and verbal.
·       Ability to create and conduct formal presentations.
·       Comfortable interacting with high-level management.
·       Skilled negotiator, able to promote and sell ideas persuasively.
·       Strong leadership and organizational skills.
·       Adaptable to change and able to work under pressure.
·       Ability to maintain confidentiality and ethical standards.
·       Strong multitasking and collaborative abilities.
·       Proficient in advanced computer systems and applications.
·       Occasional non-standard work hours or overtime as needed.
·       Professional, hybrid office environment

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Purpose:

We are seeking a curious, analytically rigorous Strategy Analyst to support the ideation, design, and activation of key organizational initiatives. While anchored in our people strategy, this role has a broad mandate that touches on operational excellence, enterprise-wide transformation, and broader business objectives.
Serving a dual mandate, the ideal candidate acts as both a strategic thought partner—helping translate ambiguous business challenges into actionable strategies—and functions in a "Chief of Staff" capacity to orchestrate the cadence of the organization. This is a high-visibility role for someone with an internal consulting mindset who thrives on conceptualizing solutions, managing complex portfolios, and turning ambiguity into structure.

Key Responsibilities:
Strategic Ideation & Problem Solving
Act as a thought partner to leadership to conceptualize and design new business and organizational strategies. Shift beyond just reporting by actively participating in the "whiteboarding" phase—identifying root causes, structuring complex problems, and proposing innovative solutions. Develop clear, executive-ready narratives and frameworks that communicate complex ideas and drive enterprise-level decision making. Thrive in a dynamic environment, bringing the same rigor and creativity whether the work is a quick-turn strategic pivot or a multi-month transformation initiative.

Chief of Staff Operations & Organizational Alignment
Serve as the central nervous system for the HR organization, keeping a pulse on the overarching portfolio of initiatives, managing operational cadence, and ensuring cross-functional alignment. Act as a connector across departments — facilitating conversations, managing dependencies, and keeping leadership informed on organizational health and project speed. Build and maintain strong working relationships across the enterprise, earning trust as a reliable and credible partner who can move forward without formal authority.

Data Analytics & Insight Generation
Gather, synthesize, and interpret qualitative and quantitative data to build the evidence base behind new strategies and operational efficiencies. Identify the right data sources, ask the right questions, and connect the dots across inputs to surface insights that drive financial and operational impact. Shape findings into clear, digestible narratives that bring the "so what" to life for senior business leaders.

Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree required, MBA or advanced degree preferred. 2–4 years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, operational excellence, or a highly analytical business role (Exposure to enterprise transformation or people-focused projects is a plus) Strong analytical capabilities with advanced proficiency in Excel and data structuring; comfort working with ambiguous or incomplete data sets to build out populations, hierarchies, and systemic efficiencies. Strategic thinker with a demonstrated ability to ideate, solve problems, and produce polished, executive-quality materials. Clear and structured communication style—both written and verbal—with an instinct for what matters to senior audiences. High organizational acumen with a proactive, self-starting approach and the ability to manage multiple workstreams with limited oversight.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Treasury
jobs.description:
Senior Director, Treasury

About the Role
TD SYNNEX is seeking a Senior Director, Treasury to lead core treasury operations across cash, liquidity, debt, and foreign exchange. In this visible, impact-driven role, you will own daily cash positioning, short-term borrowing and investing, and cash flow forecasting while strengthening our global bank relationships and optimizing working capital. You’ll design and implement cash management strategies, evaluate technologies, and oversee risk management practices that safeguard our balance sheet and support growth. This role partners closely with Finance, Accounting, Tax, Legal, and business leaders to ensure resilient liquidity, disciplined risk management, and policy compliance.

What You’ll Do
- Lead day-to-day treasury operations, including cash positioning, short-term borrowing, and deployment of excess cash.
- Own cash flow forecasting and variance analysis; deliver timely, accurate liquidity reporting and insights to leadership.
- Manage and cultivate banking relationships; negotiate services and fees, drive service-level excellence, and oversee KYC and account administration.
- Oversee letters of credit, guarantees, and trade finance instruments; ensure timely issuance, renewals, and compliance.
- Assess and manage foreign exchange exposures; develop and execute hedging strategies aligned to policy; monitor hedge effectiveness.
- Oversee interest rate risk management, evaluate debt portfolio positioning, and recommend hedging or refinancing strategies as needed.
- Design and implement cash management processes and services; champion automation and TMS utilization to improve control and efficiency.
- Evaluate treasury products, services, and systems; recommend and implement fit-for-purpose solutions.
- Maintain strong internal controls, documentation, and policy compliance (including SOX, audit support, and regulatory requirements).
- Establish and track treasury KPIs and dashboards; communicate performance and opportunities to stakeholders.
- Lead and coach team members; promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and collaboration.
- Perform additional duties as assigned to support treasury and broader finance initiatives.

What You’ll Bring
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related field required; CTP or CPA preferred.
- 8–10 years of progressive corporate treasury or finance experience, including cash management, liquidity, and bank relationship management.
- Hands-on experience with cash forecasting, working capital optimization, letters of credit/trade finance, and foreign exchange/hedging.
- Knowledge of interest rate risk, debt instruments, and short-term investments.
- Proficiency with Treasury Management Systems (TMS) and ERPs; strong Excel and analytical skills; familiarity with tools such as Kyriba, SAP, or Oracle is a plus.
- Proven leadership and team management experience; ability to influence cross-functionally and negotiate effectively.
- High attention to detail, confidentiality, and sound judgment; thrives in deadline-driven environments.

How You’ll Grow and Make an Impact
- Shape treasury strategy by advancing forecasting accuracy, strengthening bank partnerships, and improving cash returns.
- Reduce risk and cost of capital through disciplined FX and interest rate risk management.
- Lead process modernization and automation, elevating control and efficiency across global treasury operations.
- Gain exposure to senior finance leadership and cross-functional projects, creating opportunities to broaden scope and responsibility over time.

What We Offer
- A purpose-driven, inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are valued and collaboration is key.
- Professional development and learning opportunities to support continuous growth.
- Competitive total rewards, including comprehensive benefits and paid time off.
- Flexibility and support to do your best work while making a measurable impact.

jobs.title: Sr Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Shyft Global Services
Shyft Global Services is a leading technology lifecycle service provider that partners with companies around the world to shift the way they do business. Powered by a robust global logistics network, a team of outsourcing experts, and decades of experience, Shyft’s end-to-end product and customer lifecycle services enable technology companies to reinvest in growth, transformation, and innovation.

Shyft Global Services is a division of TD SYNNEX (NYSE: SNX).

About the Role
As a Senior Customer Program Manager, you will lead the post-award execution of complex customer programs for some of Shyft Global Services’ largest and most strategic accounts. You will serve as the primary customer contact and own the overall relationship, customer satisfaction, program profitability, contractual commitments, and service-level performance.
Working closely with Sales, the Global Project Management Office, and cross-functional business teams, you will translate contracts, master service agreements, statements of work, and financial models into scalable operational programs. You will establish governance, coordinate implementation, manage risks and escalations, and ensure that customer requirements become clear, actionable plans.

This is a visible, high-impact opportunity for an experienced program management professional who enjoys solving complex business challenges, influencing across teams, and helping global customers achieve meaningful outcomes. You will also have the opportunity to act as a strategic consultant, change leader, subject matter expert, and customer advocate.

What You’ll Do
- Serve as the primary day-to-day contact and trusted advisor for assigned customers.
- Lead program implementation and ongoing execution from post-award knowledge transfer through sustained delivery.
- Interpret and manage contractual obligations across master service agreements, statements of work, service-level agreements, and related program documentation.
- Own customer program financial management, including profitability tracking, forecasting, budgeting, and performance reporting.
- Monitor service-level agreements, key performance indicators, milestones, risks, and overall program health.
- Lead regular customer meetings, program reviews, and executive-level business presentations.
- Partner with customers and internal teams to define workflows, reporting requirements, governance processes, and information flows.
- Identify root causes, coordinate cross-functional issue resolution, and serve as the customer escalation point.
- Recognize out-of-scope requests and coordinate requirements for appropriate scoping, pricing, and change-order approval.
- Apply formal change-control processes when program scope, cost, budget, resources, or timelines are affected.
- Identify continuous-improvement and cost-saving opportunities that strengthen customer outcomes and program profitability.
- Maintain accurate program documentation, forecasts, business reviews, SLA reporting, and performance metrics.
- Build collaborative relationships across Sales, Finance, Legal, Operations, and other supporting functions.

What We’re Looking For
- 8 to 10 years of relevant experience in customer program management, project management, service delivery, account operations, or a related field.
- Demonstrated success managing complex customer programs, contracts, financial performance, and service-level commitments.
- Strong business and financial acumen, including forecasting, profitability analysis, and performance reporting.
- Ability to translate complex requirements into practical plans, priorities, milestones, and measurable outcomes.
- Advanced problem-solving, root-cause analysis, risk management, and decision-making skills.

- Energie krijgt van het bouwen aan sterke partnerrelaties en commerciële successen.

- Meedenkt over go-to-market plannen en marketingcampagnes.

- Nieuwsgierig is naar marktontwikkelingen en concurrentie.

jobs.description:
Job Description:
The Business IT Compensation Systems Analyst for our IT Organization will support and enhance systems, data integrations, and automated processes that enable accurate compensation and commission operations. This role will design and support automated data validation and reconciliation, develop and maintain SQL queries, scripts, and ETL/data pipelines, and continuously improve data movement, monitoring, and exception handling while advancing modernization and automation initiatives.
You will partner closely with business users, Compensation, Finance, Sales Operations, and Technology teams to translate compensation and commission requirements into reliable integrations, high-quality reporting, and effective QA, UAT, and production validations.

“Let’s Achieve Great Outcomes. TD SYNNEX is the partner that helps unlock business results for all.”

What You’ll Do:

Data Integration & Automation
- Design and support automated data validation and reconciliation processes.

- Develop and maintain SQL queries, scripts, and data pipelines supporting operational processes.

- Identify opportunities to improve data movement, monitoring, and exception handling.

- Support ongoing modernization and automation initiatives.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Act as a liaison between business users, compensation teams, finance, and technology teams.

Knowledge Skills and Experience:
- Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Finance, Business, or related field.

- 3 - 5 years of experience in data analysis, data operations, system integrations, or data engineering.

- Strong SQL development and data analysis skills.

- Experience troubleshooting data quality issues across multiple enterprise systems.

- Experience with system integrations, ETL processes, and data pipelines.

- Experience supporting QA, UAT, and production validation activities.

- Understanding compensation, commissions, incentive plan processes, and related data requirements.

- Familiarity with sales compensation workflows, quota attainment data, and commission exception handling.

- Experience with compensation systems and data

- Experience with automation tools and scripting languages.

As a Fortune 500 global company operating in over 100 countries, TD SYNNEX values its diverse workforce of 24,000 employees. Acting as a key link between vendors, country teams, and executive leadership, you will identify new opportunities, influence strategic decisions, and accelerate business performance across Europe.

jobs.title: Director, Sales - Mid-Market East & Central Commercial Sales
jobs.description:
Director, Sales - Mid-Market East & Central Commercial Sales

Job Purpose:
TD SYNNEX Canada is seeking a strategic and results-driven sales leader to lead our Mid-Market East & Central Commercial Sales organization, overseeing a business approaching $750M in annual revenue.

As Director, Sales, you will be responsible for driving profitable growth, strengthening customer and partner relationships, developing high-performing sales teams, and executing TD SYNNEX Canada's commercial sales strategy across the region. This role provides an opportunity to lead a significant business, influence key customer and partner relationships, and develop the next generation of sales leaders.

Key Areas of Accountability

Business Leadership
- Lead the Mid-Market East & Central Commercial Sales organization and deliver revenue, margin, and profitability objectives.

- Develop and execute sales strategies that accelerate growth and increase market share.

- Utilize market insights and business analytics to identify opportunities and drive performance.

Customer & Partner Engagement
- Build and maintain executive-level relationships with key customers, partners, and vendors.

- Drive customer retention, business expansion, and partner-led growth initiatives.

- Represent TD SYNNEX within the Canadian technology and channel ecosystem.

People Leadership
- Lead, coach, and develop a team of Sales Managers and Client Executives.

- Foster a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and customer success.

- Build leadership capability through coaching, mentoring, and succession planning.

Strategic Execution
- Translate company priorities into actionable sales plans and business strategies.

- Drive forecasting accuracy, pipeline health, account planning, and sales productivity.

- Partner across Finance, Marketing, Vendor Management, Services, and Operations to deliver business results.

Operational Excellence
- Lead business reviews, forecasting processes, and performance management activities.

- Ensure disciplined execution of sales processes, governance, and business planning practices.

Responsibilities and Requirements:
- 15+ years of progressive commercial sales, channel, or related business leadership experience.

- Demonstrated leadership capability and potential to lead and develop sales teams, including leaders. Direct sales team leadership experience is preferred; high-potential internal candidates who meet the other role requirements may also be considered.

- Experience managing a commercial sales organization with accountability for significant revenue and profitability.

- Demonstrated ownership of a $250M+ P&L.

- Strong experience working with technology vendors, channel partners, and customers.

- Proven ability to influence, coach, mentor, and develop talent, with a commitment to building high-performing teams and future leaders.

- Strong executive presence with the ability to influence customers, partners, and senior leadership.

- Experience developing and executing strategic sales plans that drive measurable business growth.

- Ability to travel approximately 15-20%.

- Must be based in or willing to work from the Montreal, QC, Canada office.

Preferred
- Experience within technology distribution, channel sales, or the IT solutions industry.

- Experience leading teams within the Canadian market.

Salary Range Requirement
Actual annual compensation offered will be based on several variables including geographic location, work experience, education and skills/ achievements, and will be mutually agreed upon at the time of offer.

- This salary range for this position is $136,000 - $182,000 CAD

Why Join TD SYNNEX?
This is an opportunity to lead one of TD SYNNEX Canada's most significant commercial sales organizations, oversee a business approaching $750M in annual revenue, develop future sales leaders, and help shape the growth strategy for a market-leading technology distributor and solutions aggregator.

Directeur(trice), Ventes – Marché intermédiaire (Est et Centre), Ventes commerciales

Objectif du poste:
TD SYNNEX Canada recherche un(e) leader des ventes stratégique et axé(e) sur les résultats pour diriger notre organisation des Ventes commerciales du marché intermédiaire (Est et Centre), supervisant une entreprise approchant 750 M$ de revenus annuels.

À titre de directeur(trice) des ventes, vous serez responsable de stimuler la croissance rentable, de renforcer les relations avec les clients et partenaires, de développer des équipes de vente performantes et d’exécuter la stratégie de ventes commerciales de TD SYNNEX Canada dans la région. Ce rôle offre l’occasion de diriger une unité d’affaires d’envergure, d’influencer des relations clés avec des clients et partenaires, et de développer la prochaine génération de leaders en vente.

Principaux domaines de responsabilité
Leadership d’affaires
- Diriger l’organisation des Ventes commerciales du marché intermédiaire (Est et Centre) et atteindre les objectifs de revenus, de marge et de rentabilité.

- Élaborer et exécuter des stratégies de vente qui accélèrent la croissance et augmentent la part de marché.

- Mettre à profit les perspectives de marché et l’analytique d’affaires pour identifier des opportunités et stimuler la performance.

Relations avec les clients et les partenaires
- Établir et entretenir des relations de niveau exécutif avec des clients, partenaires et fournisseurs clés.

- Stimuler la fidélisation des clients, l’expansion des affaires et les initiatives de croissance menées par les partenaires.

- Représenter TD SYNNEX au sein de l’écosystème canadien des technologies et du canal.

Leadership des talents
- Diriger, coacher et développer une équipe de gestionnaires des ventes et de gestionnaires de comptes.

- Favoriser une culture de haute performance axée sur la responsabilisation, la collaboration et la réussite client.

- Renforcer les capacités de leadership par le coaching, le mentorat et la planification de la relève.

Exécution stratégique
- Traduire les priorités de l’entreprise en plans de vente concrets et en stratégies d’affaires.

- Améliorer la justesse des prévisions, la santé du pipeline des ventes, la planification des comptes et la productivité des ventes.

- Collaborer avec les équipes Finance, Marketing, Gestion des fournisseurs, Services et Opérations pour générer des résultats d’affaires.

Excellence opérationnelle
- Diriger les revues d’affaires, les processus de prévision et les activités de gestion de la performance.

- Assurer une exécution disciplinée des processus de vente, de la gouvernance et des pratiques de planification des activités.

Responsabilités et exigences:
- Plus de 15 ans d’expérience progressive en ventes commerciales, en canaux de distribution ou en direction d’entreprise connexe.

- Capacité démontrée à diriger et développer des équipes de vente, y compris des leaders. Une expérience directe de gestion d’équipes de vente est privilégiée; des candidats internes à fort potentiel répondant aux autres exigences peuvent aussi être considérés.

- Expérience de la gestion d’une organisation de ventes commerciales avec responsabilité de revenus et de rentabilité significatifs.

- Responsabilité démontrée d’un P&L de plus de 250 M$.

- Solide expérience de collaboration avec des fournisseurs technologiques, des partenaires de canal et des clients.

- Aptitude éprouvée à influencer, coacher, mentorer et développer les talents, avec un engagement envers la création d’équipes performantes et de futurs leaders.

- Forte présence exécutive, avec la capacité d’influencer les clients, les partenaires et la haute direction.

- Expérience en élaboration et exécution de plans stratégiques de vente générant une croissance mesurable.

- Capacité de voyager environ 15 à 20 %.

- Doit être basé(e) à Montréal (QC) ou prêt(e) à travailler à partir du bureau de Montréal (QC).

El/La Gerente de Desarrollo de Negocios (DELL-CSG [Client Solutions Group] ) para nuestra organización de CCA (Caribe y Centroamérica) Se enfoca en construir y mantener relaciones comerciales con los fabricantes/proveedores asignados de TD SYNNEX para alcanzar el mejor desempeño financiero.
Es responsable de posicionar TD SYNNEX directamente ante el fabricante/proveedor y actúa como experto/a en la materia (SME) en las tecnologías y programas del fabricante.
Comunica las estrategias del fabricante, gestiona programas de bonificaciones (rebates), desarrolla programas que apoyan la dirección de la unidad de negocio y colabora con Marketing para impulsar la demanda.

“Logremos grandes resultados. TD SYNNEX es el socio que ayuda a potenciar los resultados empresariales para todos.”

Se anima a postularse a candidatos de Panamá, Guatemala y El Salvador.

Lo que harás:
- Dirige y gestiona el plan de negocio del fabricante y su implementación en toda la organización, aprovechando las fortalezas y recursos del fabricante en su representación.

- Comunica las estrategias y beneficios del fabricante a las diferentes organizaciones/unidades de TD SYNNEX.

- Responsable de propuestas de financiamiento incremental a nivel de fabricante.

- Alinea los objetivos y metas del fabricante con los de TD SYNNEX para asegurar resultados positivos y mutuos.

- Desarrolla, monitorea y recomienda planes para la relación comercial fabricante–TD SYNNEX a nivel táctico y estratégico.

- Realiza revisiones trimestrales del negocio con el fabricante.

- Identifica y promueve nuevas oportunidades con fabricantes, con énfasis en desarrollar nuevos servicios que combinen recursos/capacidades únicas del fabricante con servicios/capacidades de TD SYNNEX, creando una propuesta de valor diferenciada.

- Impulsa la comunicación transversal con los grupos de producto de TD SYNNEX en negociaciones de precios y conocimiento del mercado.

- Actúa como experto/a en la materia (SME) de las tecnologías y programas del fabrica

- nte asignado.

- Gestiona actividades y programas que impulsen el desempeño proforma del fabricante para alcanzar las metas financieras de TD SYNNEX.

- Realiza análisis e informes sobre el impacto de diversos programas para el fabricante.

- Gestiona el pipeline de pronóstico y las proyecciones de bonificaciones (rebates).

- Realiza otras funciones adicionales según se le asignen.

Lo que buscamos:
- Título universitario o experiencia equivalente que permita obtener conocimientos y habilidades laborales comparables.

- Más de 3 años de experiencia laboral relevante.

- Amplio conocimiento y aplicación de principios, teorías y conceptos.

- Conocimiento completo de todas las funciones del puesto y de las mejores prácticas, técnicas y estándares del sector.

- Desarrolla soluciones a problemas complejos donde el análisis de situaciones o datos requiere una evaluación profunda de variables.

- Determina el mejor método para lograr resultados y puede proponer mejoras a políticas y procedimientos.

- El trabajo se realiza sin supervisión apreciable, utilizando juicio independiente y discreción. Ejerce amplia autonomía para determinar objetivos y enfoques. El trabajo puede revisarse a un nivel alto.

- Representa a la organización como contacto principal en proyectos o contratos. Interactúa con frecuencia con profesionales senior y con la gerencia, y a menudo coordina el trabajo entre departamentos u organizaciones.

- Sus acciones impactan a la organización. No cumplir con el trabajo o tomar decisiones erróneas puede impedir alcanzar objetivos organizacionales cruciales y tener un efecto prolongado, además de implicar el gasto de recursos significativos.

Educación/Certificaciones:
- Dominio del inglés (nivel B2 o superior). Deseable

- 5+ años de experiencia comercial. Deseable

- Certificaciones en soluciones o productos DELL. Deseable

Condiciones de trabajo:
- Viajes según sea necesario.

- Entorno profesional (Remoto).

- Ocasionalmente se requerirán horarios laborales no convencionales u horas extra, según las necesidades del negocio.

jobs.description:
Arbeiten bei TD SYNNEX:

TD SYNNEX ist ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen in der IT-Distribution. Wir bringen Technologiehersteller mit Vertriebspartnern (vom Fachhändler über Retailer bis hin zu Corporate-B2B-Partnern und IT-Spezialisten) zusammen und sorgen dafür, dass moderne IT-Lösungen erfolgreich eingesetzt werden – von Hardware und Software bis zu Cloud-, AI- und Serviceangeboten.
Mit rund 23.000 Mitarbeitenden, mehr als 150.000 Kunden und über 2.500 Technologiepartnern sind wir in über 100 Ländern aktiv. Unser globales Headquarter befindet sich in den USA, mit starken regionalen Teams – auch in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz.
Die IT-Branche zählt zu den dynamischsten überhaupt. Bei TD SYNNEX bedeutet das: tägliche Abwechslung, neue Herausforderungen und die Möglichkeit, aktiv an der digitalen Zukunft mitzuwirken. Digitalisierung, effiziente Prozesse und innovative Geschäftsmodelle gehören für uns genauso dazu wie Zusammenarbeit, Eigenverantwortung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung.
Ob Vertriebsprofi, Technikenthusiast, analytischer oder kreativer Kopf – als von „Great Place to Work®“ ausgezeichneter Arbeitgeber vereint TD SYNNEX Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Stärken und einem gemeinsamen Ziel: Technologie nutzbar zu machen und Kunden erfolgreich zu unterstützen.

Dein Ziel:

Als Business Manager Apple übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle bei der Weiterentwicklung unseres Apple-Geschäfts. Du arbeitest eng mit Apple, internen Fachbereichen und Vertriebsteams zusammen und trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, Produkte erfolgreich im Markt zu positionieren, Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern und neue Geschäftspotenziale zu identifizieren.
Dabei verbindest Du analytisches Denken mit kommerziellem Verständnis und arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen Hersteller, Vertrieb, Einkauf, Marketing, Business Intelligence und Finance.

Dein Verantwortungsbereich:
- Du setzt die gemeinsam definierte Business-Unit-Strategie erfolgreich um und trägst dazu bei, profitables Wachstum und Marktanteile nachhaltig auszubauen.
- Gemeinsam mit unseren Pricing- und Profitability-Teams unterstützt Du die Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Preisstrategie und begleitest Ausnahmeentscheidungen im Tagesgeschäft.
- Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Business-Intelligence-Team zusammen, analysierst Markt- und Geschäftsdaten und leitest daraus fundierte Empfehlungen sowie neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten ab.
- Du verantwortest den gesamten Produkt- und Lieferantenlebenszyklus – von der Produktanlage und Datenpflege über Produktadoptionen bis hin zum Vertragsmanagement.
- Als zentrale Schnittstelle zu Apple pflegst Du die operativen und kommerziellen Beziehungen zu wichtigen Ansprechpartnern und stellst eine vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit sicher.
- Du identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale in bestehenden Geschäfts- und Prozessabläufen und treibst deren Umsetzung aktiv voran.
- Du sorgst für die konsequente Nutzung unserer CRM- und Business-Systeme und unterstützt damit effiziente Prozesse sowie nachhaltige Geschäftskontinuität.
- Du wirkst aktiv an der Erstellung und Umsetzung von Quartalsplanungen sowie gemeinsamen Business-Plänen mit dem Hersteller mit.

Deine Expertise:
- Ausgeprägtes Zahlenverständnis und analytische Stärke
- Hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Organisationstalent
- Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern
- Erfahrung im Business Planning sowie eine strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Kaufmännisches Verständnis und ein gutes Gespür für Markt- und Geschäftsentwicklungen
- Berufserfahrung in der IT-Branche, idealerweise in den Bereichen Category Management, Einkauf, Produktmanagement, Produktmarketing oder Business Development
- Sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft Office, insbesondere Excel
- Erfahrung mit SAP R/3, Business Warehouse oder vergleichbaren ERP- und Reporting-Systemen
- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Neugierig? Dann komm zu TD SYNNEX und bewirb Dich JETZT mit vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen! Wir bieten Dir:
- Einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag mit einer attraktiven Vergütung sowie vermögenswirksame Leistungen und 30 Tagen Urlaub
- Flexibles Arbeiten im hybriden Arbeitsmodell (2 Tage Office / 3 Tage Homeoffice)
- Freie Platzwahl (Buchungssystem) und moderne Arbeitsplatzausstattungen mit höhenverstellbaren Tischen, ergonomischen Stühlen und jeweils 2 Bildschirmen
- Interessante abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben in einem zukunftsorientierten Umfeld mit viel Eigenverantwortung und der Möglichkeit, Strukturen und Prozesse aktiv und selbstständig mitzugestalten
- Vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und enge Schnittstellen zur IT-Technik (z. B. IoT, Security) mit der Chance, hier weitere Fachexpertise aufzubauen
- Tolle Programme für spezielle Gruppen, z.B. Mentoring Programm, Themenveranstaltungen für LGBTQ&I u.v.m., die von Business Ressource Groups gestaltet werden

jobs.description:
Do you thrive on building relationships, closing deals, and driving growth?
The mobile market is evolving faster than ever. New technologies, AI-driven productivity, changing customer demands, and innovative business models are creating exciting opportunities for those who are passionate about business development and sales.

We're looking for a Business Development Manager (Mobile B2B) to join our team and help drive growth for some of the industry's leading mobile vendors, including Google Pixel and other strategic brands within our product portfolio.

This is a highly commercial role where success is measured by your ability to identify opportunities, build strategic partnerships, develop a strong sales pipeline, and deliver measurable business results across the Swedish market.

You will act as an extension of our vendors' sales organizations while supporting reseller partners in winning new business, increasing market share, and helping customers adopt modern mobile workplace solutions.

The Role
As a Business Development Manager, you will play a pivotal role in driving growth across assigned vendors and customer segments within the Mobile B2B market.
Operating at the intersection of leading technology vendors, TD SYNNEX, and our network of reseller and telecom partners, you will help transform vendor ambitions into measurable commercial success. Through strong channel engagement, customer-facing activities, and strategic business planning, you will create growth opportunities and accelerate market adoption.
This is a highly visible and entrepreneurial role that offers significant freedom, responsibility, and influence. You will be trusted to manage your own business, prioritize activities, and create momentum across customers, partners, and vendors. With this level of ownership comes the responsibility to meet vendor expectations and deliver against agreed targets and specific KPIs.
Success requires a proactive mindset, commercial curiosity, and a strong drive to convert opportunities into results. You will work toward clearly defined business objectives and KPIs, with performance measured on an ongoing basis.

Key Responsibilities
Vendor & Business Development
- Translate vendor strategies and objectives into actionable business plans.
- Drive growth and market share development across assigned vendors and customer segments.
- Manage vendor relationships and contribute to Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and strategic planning activities.
- Provide market insights, competitive intelligence, and commercial recommendations to vendors.
- Support the execution of vendor-funded marketing activities, incentives, and growth programs.

Channel Development & Sales Execution
- Develop and strengthen strategic relationships across the reseller and telecom partner ecosystem.

- Enable and support partner sales teams through training, customer engagement, and joint business activities.

- Conduct customer meetings and partner engagements to generate new business opportunities and accelerate sales cycles.

- Increase vendor visibility and presence both internally within TD SYNNEX and externally across the market.

- Drive strategic sales opportunities and build a healthy, sustainable pipeline.

Commercial & Financial Management
- Negotiate commercial agreements, incentives, discounts, and other business terms.
- Contribute to purchasing, pricing, sales, and inventory strategies.
- Understand and actively manage the commercial drivers of the business, including gross margin, vendor rebates, working capital, inventory turn, and profitability.
- Use forecasting, pipeline management, and market analysis to support sound business decisions.
- Balance growth, availability, and financial performance to create long-term value for vendors, partners, and TD SYNNEX.
- Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline management on a weekly basis.

You are a commercially driven sales professional with a passion for building relationships, identifying opportunities, and creating profitable business growth.
You understand that modern mobility is about more than devices. You can connect customer needs with business value and work effectively with vendors, partners, and end customers to drive successful outcomes.
Whether you're presenting to decision-makers, negotiating a commercial agreement, or developing a joint business plan with a partner, you know how to build credibility and move opportunities forward.

To be successful in this role, you should have:
- 3-5 years of experience in sales, business development, channel management, or a related commercial role within IT, telecom, mobility, or technology.
- A strong network among resellers, operators, vendors, and key decision-makers in the Swedish market.
- A proven track record of building pipeline, driving growth, and delivering sales results.
- Strong commercial acumen and a solid understanding of distributor economics, including profitability, rebates, margins, working capital, inventory management, and business planning.
- Experience working with vendor relationships and managing multiple stakeholders.
- A results-oriented mindset with a strong drive to win new business and exceed targets.
- Excellent planning and organizational skills, with the ability to independently manage your workload and deliver against predefined KPIs.
- Experience working with CRM platforms and sales management tools.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills in both Swedish and English, written and verbal.
- A valid driver's license and willingness to travel within Sweden.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience from an IT distributor, mobile vendor, telecom operator, or reseller organization.

- Familiarity with enterprise mobility solutions, mobile device management platforms, or modern workplace technologies.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager NetApp
jobs.description:
Krijg jij energie van het leggen van nieuwe contacten en het opbouwen van duurzame klantrelaties? Vind je het leuk om kansen te herkennen, het gesprek aan te gaan en samen met klanten te bouwen aan een succesvolle samenwerking? Ben je communicatief sterk, overtuigend op een natuurlijke manier en voel je je thuis in een netwerkgerichte rol?
Dan komen we graag met je in gesprek.

Kom werken bij de grootste (en leukste) IT-distributeur van Nederland: TD SYNNEX gecertificeerd als Great Place to Work!

Functieomschrijving
Wij zijn op zoek naar een commercieel talent in de buitendienst dat energie krijgt van het helpen van organisaties bij het oplossen van (complexe) IT‑vraagstukken. Als Business Development Manager binnen de Data Center‑divisie voor NetApp sta je dicht bij de klant en luister je naar hun uitdagingen rondom data, continuïteit, groei en innovatie. Vanuit oprechte interesse in de business van de klant help je hen grip te krijgen op hun data en IT‑omgeving, zodat technologie geen belemmering is, maar juist een versneller van hun ambities. Je bouwt langdurige relaties op, denkt mee over toekomstbestendige datacenteroplossingen en begeleidt klanten bij belangrijke keuzes die impact hebben op hun organisatie. Samen met partners en interne specialisten werk je aan oplossingen die écht verschil maken. Niet omdat het moet, maar omdat je gelooft dat goed ingerichte IT organisaties helpt om beter te presteren, te innoveren en vooruit te kijken.

Daarnaast:
- Beheer en ontwikkel kleine tot middelgrote klantaccounts van gemiddelde complexiteit met enige supervisie, met als doel het winnen van nieuwe klanten en het maximaliseren van het accountpotentieel

- Verhoog de klantloyaliteit en winstgevendheid door optimaal gebruik te maken van je uitgebreide kennis van de toegewezen product- en dienstlijnen

- Vergroot het marktaandeel van TD SYNNEX bij leveranciers door effectieve strategieën en relaties

- Vertaal leveranciersdoelstellingen naar uitvoerbare bedrijfsplannen en ondersteun de realisatie van doelen in het businessplan

- Beheer grote deals en ontwikkel pijplijnen binnen een specifiek technologiedomein, inclusief onderhandelingen over deals en kortingen

- Leverage strategische input in leveranciersmarktaanbiedingen en ondersteun de ontwikkeling en uitvoering van marketingplannen in samenwerking met de Marketing Manager.

- Werk nauw samen met het Field Sales Team (FSE) en onderhoud sterke relaties met relevante contacten bij leveranciers

- Zorg voor nauwkeurige en tijdige wekelijkse prognoses en pijplijnontwikkelingen om continue groei te garanderen

- Bouw sterke relaties op met zowel generieke als gespecialiseerde verkoopteams binnen TD SYNNEX om samenwerking en synergie te bevorderen

- Onderhoud en ontwikkel relaties met leveranciers en klanten om de aanwezigheid en het profiel van TD SYNNEX zowel intern als extern te versterken

Jij:
- Hebt 3-5  jaar werkervaring in de IT-industrie op een business development-niveau, bij voorkeur in channel sales
- Hebt ervaring met datacenter- en cloudoplossingen
- Ervaring met NetApp is een pré
- Beheerst zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal vloeiend in woord en geschrift
- Bent communicatief sterk
- Beschikt over sterke organisatorische, tijds- en projectmanagementvaardigheden waarmee je taken succesvol kunt afronden
- Bent in staat om op een positieve en effectieve manier te communiceren met mensen op verschillende niveaus binnen de organisatie en met externe partners
- Bent een proactieve zelfstarter die in staat is om duidelijke individuele, team- en bedrijfsprioriteiten te definiëren en op eigen initiatief uit te voeren
- Hebt een sterke oriëntatie op en ervaring in diensten- en oplossingsverkoop.
- Bent in staat om gedegen businessplannen op te stellen en hebt ervaring met strategische planning en het ontwikkelen van businesscases
- Kan technische concepten (cloud, storage, security, infra) uitleggen in begrijpelijke taal
- Legt de koppeling tussen IT en bedrijfsdoelen (kosten, continuïteit, groei, compliance)
- Weet wanneer hij/zij zelf kan adviseren en wanneer pre‑sales moet worden aangehaakt

Wij:
- Bieden jou fun en uitdaging in een job die geen dag dezelfde is, omringd met enthousiaste collega’s

- Vinden work-life balance belangrijk en na een inwerkperiode kan je tot twee dagen per week van thuis werken

- Bieden jou een compleet onboarding programma inclusief een begeleide rondleiding in ons magazijn

- Zetten in op jouw development met een ruim aanbod aan trainings- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden

- Organiseren heel wat Well@Work initiatieven gaande van fruit op het werk, sportactiviteiten en hebben een actieve personeelsvereniging ,

- Zorgen voor een mooi salarispakket + auto ,

- Last but not least, we beschikken over een echt lekkere koffie ;)

We are seeking a highly motivated and dynamic individual for the position of Business Development Executive I. The successful candidate must be willing to spend 50% or more of their time in the field, engaging with customers and vendors. As a Business Development Executive I, you will be responsible for creating and maintaining customer relationships, both on the vendor and customer side. You will travel extensively to conduct face-to-face meetings with our target account base.

What You’ll Do

- Creating reports and presentations and delivering group and management presentations at customer sites.

- Executing against vendor initiatives and serving as a subject matter expert (SME) on assigned vendor's brand, technology solutions, and program offerings for our customers.

- Identifying and creating opportunity demand for products, coordinating seminars, training, and resource awareness for assigned customers to drive growth.

- Performing analysis and reporting results of various program impact for identified customers, communicating success, issues, and future growth plan strategies to the Account Manager.

- Maintaining up-to-date knowledge of products, competitors, technology, and customers in the assigned supplier product market.

- Building and nurturing field vendor relationships.

- Collaborating with the sales organization as a vendor SME and providing value-added solutions to drive sales growth.

- Frequent regional travel. Candidates must have reliable access to personal transportation and be able to self‑drive to client locations, including same‑day trips of 3+ hours one way. Rideshare/on‑demand services are not acceptable for business travel in this role.

What We’re Looking For
- 3-5 years of sales experience preferred.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required.

- Thorough knowledge of solutions and assigned products.

- Ability to deliver strategic vendor solutions and identify new partners.

- Established relationships with key vendor contacts.

- Proficient in communication, negotiation, and collaboration.

- Strong organizational and time management skills.

- Ability to work independently and multitask effectively.

- Comfortable with technology and basic office tasks.

- Willingness to travel and occasionally work non-standard hours.

- Remote/work-from-home capability.

Nous sommes à la recherche d’une personne hautement motivée et dynamique pour occuper le poste de Spécialiste, développement des affaires I. La personne retenue devra consacrer 50 % de son temps ou plus sur le terrain, en interaction avec des clientes et clients ainsi que des fournisseurs. - Repérer et générer la demande pour les produits; coordonner des séminaires, des formations et la sensibilisation aux ressources auprès des clients assignés afin de stimuler la croissance.

- Réaliser des analyses et rendre compte des résultats liés à l’impact de divers programmes pour les clients ciblés; communiquer les réussites, les enjeux et les stratégies de croissance future au ou à la gestionnaire de comptes.

- Établir et entretenir des relations sur le terrain avec les fournisseurs.

- Collaborer avec l’organisation des ventes en tant qu’expert(e) fournisseur et proposer des solutions à valeur ajoutée pour favoriser la croissance des ventes.

Profil recherché

- Baccalauréat ou expérience équivalente exigé(e).

- Connaissance approfondie des solutions et des produits assignés.

- Capacité à proposer des solutions stratégiques de fournisseurs et à identifier de nouveaux partenaires.

- Relations établies avec des interlocutrices et interlocuteurs clés chez les fournisseurs.

- Excellentes aptitudes en communication, négociation et collaboration.

- Solides compétences en organisation et en gestion du temps.

- Capacité à travailler de façon autonome et à gérer plusieurs tâches simultanément.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager - HPE
jobs.description:
Business Development Manager - HPE

Bli en nøkkelspiller i vår HPE-virksomhet hos TD SYNNEX Norge
TD SYNNEX søker en strategisk og proaktiv Business Development Manager (BDM) med ansvar for å drive og utvikle vår HPE-virksomhet i Norge. Du vil bli en del av et sterkt nordisk team og få en sentral rolle i å bygge relasjoner, drive vekst og maksimere forretningspotensialet innen HPE sine løsninger.

Om rollen

Som BDM for HPE vil du være ansvarlig for både strategisk utvikling og gjennomføring av vårt salgsarbeid. Du vil jobbe tett sammen med interne salgs- og markedsføringsteam, HPE sin egen organisasjon og våre viktigste partnere og kunder. Rollen krever et sterkt kommersielt tankesett, teknologiforståelse og evnen til å skape verdi i komplekse B2B-miljøer.

Dine ansvarsområder
- Utvikle og implementere en salgsstrategi for HPE sine løsninger og tjenester i det norske markedet

- Bygge og opprettholde relasjoner med partnere, kunder og HPE sitt lokale team

- Drive pipelinebygging og sikre vekst gjennom nye og eksisterende kunder

- Identifisere markedsmuligheter, lansere kampanjer og støtte go-to-market-initiativer

- Samarbeide med markedsføring og salgsorganisasjonen om leadgenerering og salgsaktiviteter

- Delta i kundemøter, forhandleraktiviteter og strategiske QBRs

- Følge opp på ytelse, utarbeide prognoser og sikre målbare resultater

- Representere TD SYNNEX og HPE på arrangementer og i nettverk

Hvem er du?
- Du har minst 3-5 års erfaring med B2B-salg eller forretningsutvikling – gjerne med erfaring fra HPE, datacenter eller IT-infrastruktur

- Du har sterke relasjonelle ferdigheter og evnen til å bygge tillit hos både kunder og leverandører

- Du er forretningsorientert, strategisk tenkende og trives i en selvstendig rolle

- Du har erfaring med å jobbe i komplekse økosystemer med flere interessenter

- Du kommuniserer flytende på både norsk og engelsk

- Du jobber strukturert, har et godt overblikk og er vant til å levere resultater

Søknad
Vi behandler søknader løpende og oppfordrer deg til å registrere din interesse så raskt som mulig.
Vil du vite mer om TD SYNNEX, kan du lese om oss på TD SYNNEX Norway 2024

Hvorfor velge TD SYNNEX?
Som et Fortune 500-selskap som opererer i mer enn 100 land, verdsetter TD SYNNEX sin mangfoldige arbeidsstyrke på 22.000 ansatte. jobs.title: Business Development Manager - Cloud
jobs.description:
Varför välja TD SYNNEX:

Som ett globalt Fortune 500-företag, verksamt i över 100 länder, värdesätter TD SYNNEX sin mångsidiga arbetsstyrka på 24 000 anställda. Som världens största IT-distributör är vårt uppdrag att tillhandahålla förstklassiga teknologilösningar och ge företag och individer möjlighet att navigera i den digitala världen på ett säkert och effektivt sätt.

Om rollen:
Som Business Development Manager för Microsoft Azure får du en central kommersiell roll i utvecklingen av TD SYNNEX svenska Azure-affär.
Du ansvarar för att identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter, rekrytera och aktivera partners samt hjälpa etablerade partners att utveckla och skala sin Azure-affär. Du arbetar marknadsorienterat, prioriterar insatser utifrån affärspotential och bidrar till den övergripande affärsplanen tillsammans med Microsoft, interna specialistteam och TD SYNNEX ledning.
Rollen passar dig som har erfarenhet av partnerutveckling, kanalförsäljning eller affärsutveckling och som har en god förståelse för Azure och molnaffären. Du behöver inte vara lösningsarkitekt, men du ska kunna föra en inledande lösningsdialog, kvalificera kundens behov och involvera rätt teknisk kompetens när affären kräver det.
En viktig del av rollen är också att identifiera hur TD SYNNEX support-, tjänste- och finansieringserbjudanden kan stärka partnerns lösning och skapa ett större affärsvärde för slutkunden.

Vad du kommer att göra:
- Rekrytera nya återförsäljare och utveckla deras affär tillsammans med TD SYNNEX.
- Aktivera partners som ännu inte har etablerat en skalbar Azure-affär.
- Hjälpa aktiva partners att skapa tillväxt genom nya Azure-lösningar, tjänster och kommersiella paketeringar.
- Utveckla och genomföra den kommersiella planen för Microsoft Azure i Sverige.
- Prioritera partners, affärsmöjligheter och initiativ utifrån potential, lönsamhet och genomförbarhet.
- Driva utvalda strategiska affärer och stötta säljteamet i andra affärsmöjligheter.
- Föra inledande lösningsdialoger, kvalificera behov och samla rätt kommersiella och tekniska kompetenser kring affären.
- Positionera TD SYNNEX befintliga support-, tjänste- och finansieringserbjudanden som en del av partnerns lösning.
- Planera och genomföra partneraktiviteter, exempelvis webbinarier, hackathons, workshops och roadshows.
- Bygga och utveckla starka relationer med Microsoft, återförsäljare och andra viktiga intressenter.
- Följa upp kommersiella resultat, partneraktivering, pipeline och genomförda initiativ.

Vi tror att du har:
- Minst tre års relevant erfarenhet av partnerutveckling, kanalförsäljning, affärsutveckling eller komplex B2B-försäljning inom IT.
- Erfarenhet av att arbeta med återförsäljare, partners eller andra indirekta försäljningskanaler.
- God förståelse för Microsoft Azure eller en jämförbar molnplattform.
- Förmåga att föra övergripande lösningsdiskussioner och kvalificera behov innan tekniska specialister involveras.
- Förmåga att förstå partnerns och slutkundens verksamhet och omsätta identifierade behov till relevanta kommersiella erbjudanden.
- Erfarenhet av att självständigt ta initiativ och driva aktiviteter från idé till genomförande.
- Ett affärsmässigt och strukturerat arbetssätt samt förmåga att prioritera mellan flera parallella möjligheter.
- Flytande svenska och mycket god engelska i tal och skrift.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Microsoft CSP, Azure consumption, IT-distribution, supportavtal, managed services eller professional services.

Vem vi tror att du är:

jobs.title: Business Development Executive (AWS)
jobs.description:
Por qué elegir TD SYNNEX
Como una corporación global Fortune 500, número 64, operando en más de 100 países, TD SYNNEX valora su diversa plantilla de 22.000 empleados. Como el mayor distribuidor de tecnología del mundo, nuestra misión es aportar soluciones y servicios de valor que ayuden a nuestros partners y fabricantes a crecer en un mercado en constante evolución, impulsando la innovación y el desarrollo tecnológico en todos los segmentos, incluido el Retail.

Propósito del puesto:
Actuar como Business Development Executive para impulsar actividades de aceleración comercial en colaboración con Amazon Web Services (AWS) . La misión principal será fomentar el crecimiento rentable de la cuota de mercado mediante la ejecución de planes de negocio, la gestión del pipeline y la habilitación y dinamización comercial tanto de los equipos de ventas como de los clientes y partners.

Qué és lo que harás:
- Colaborar con los equipos de negocio y ventas de AWS para apoyar la gestión y desarrollo de los partners.

- Adquirir un alto nivel de conocimiento tanto de las soluciones AWS como del negocio de TD SYNNEX para dar respuesta a las necesidades de los partners.

- Apoyar de forma proactiva la ejecución de planes de negocio y marketing orientados al crecimiento.

- Gestionar actividades de generación de demanda y seguimiento de oportunidades a través de herramientas como AWS CRM, APN y ACE .

- Mantener una relación continua con AWS con el objetivo de generar leads y oportunidades para los partners.

- Comunicar a los partners información relativa a productos, precios y promociones a través de la unidad de negocio AWS.

- Promover y comercializar los servicios cloud y de e-business de TD SYNNEX.

- Colaborar estrechamente con los equipos de ventas cloud para garantizar el cumplimiento de los objetivos de negocio.

Qué buscamos en ti:
- Nivel alto de inglés, imprescindible.

- Clara orientación al cliente y al partner.

- Experiencia participando en la ejecución de planes de negocio y estrategias comerciales.

- Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, networking con fabricantes y gestión de reuniones.

- Conocimientos de AWS Cloud; se valorará especialmente certificación AWS Cloud Practitioner o superior.

- Proactividad, iniciativa y excelentes habilidades interpersonales.

- Capacidad para influir, motivar y colaborar con equipos comerciales.

- Experiencia en gestión estructurada de actividad comercial, oportunidades y reporting.

- Alto nivel de autonomía, energía y orientación a resultados.

- Buen conocimiento del sector IT, incluyendo fabricantes, canal de distribución, competencia y tendencias de mercado.

- Conocimientos de SAP R/3 y Business Warehouse serán valorados positivamente.

- Dominio de herramientas Microsoft Office: Word, Excel, PowerPoint y Outlook.

- Habilidades de venta telefónica y generación de oportunidades.

- Titulación universitaria en Administración de Empresas, Comercio, Marketing o similar, valorable.

🛡️ Seguro de vida: cobertura con Generali para mayor tranquilidad y protección.

- Adoption Growth – Drive increased usage and engagement through proactive outreach.

- Experience: 3–5 years in Customer Success, Renewals, or Account Management (preferably in SaaS or CAD industry).

- Ability to manage multiple accounts efficiently with attention to detail.

jobs.title: Director, Category Management
jobs.description:
The role of a Director of Advanced Solutions is to manage and lead a team of product managers who manages a portfolio of advanced solutions products distributed by the company. They perform a range of tasks to ensure profitable growth of their respective products and efficient stock management. These include implementing business strategies, optimizing working capital and profitability, evaluating new product or business opportunities, managing vendor relationships and supervising employees.

Job Description:
We are looking for an experienced Director of Advanced Solutions to lead and grow the Advanced Solutions products portfolio by meeting the expectations of both the vendors and company. You will be responsible for ensuring the efficiency use of resources and working capital as well as setting strategic goals for the future aligned to the company overall direction. The ideal candidate will be well-versed in all matters business. They will be a competent leader able to provide guidance that enhances performance in a manner which incorporates the company’s vision and culture.
The goal will be to ensure the profitability of our company’s activities to drive sustainable development and long-term success.

Responsibilities:
- Develop goals, priorities, area of focus and strategies for Advanced Solutions towards profitable growth and working capital optimization.

- Lead, guide and motivate a team of Business Managers and Product Managers to design and implement business plans and strategies to promote the attainment of company and vendors goals

- Maintain close relationships with all vendors and key partners clear understanding of their expectations.

- Constantly updated with market information from various sources and able to act quickly to market changes. Ensure that the company has the adequate and suitable skilled resources to effectively deliver results.

- Keenly monitor performance benchmark in market share, profitability, inventory level and team’s KPIs.

- Close collaboration and alignment of plans with internal sales team and regional business unit.

- Optimize each product in the portfolio to identify opportunities to grow or to discontinue.

- Act as the primary representative of the company in events, conferences etc for Advanced Solutions products.

- Ensure adherence to all legal rules and guidelines of the company

Requirements and skills:
- Proven experience as product management lead or relevant role in IT industry. Must have at least 7 years of managing a team of no less than 10 persons.

- Highly analytical with a keen attention to detail. Has good understanding of data analysis techniques and financials

- Thorough understanding of diverse business processes and strategy development.

- Able to effectively balance multiple priorities and keep pace with the fast-moving market.

- Excellent organizational, leadership and coaching skills

- Outstanding communication and interpersonal abilities

- Team player who collaborates well with others

Business Management Qualifications/Skills:
- Performance management

- Business Development

- Strategic Planning

- Communication skills

- Financials

- People management

- Fostering teamwork

jobs.title: Business Development Manager (Lenovo) - CCA
jobs.description:
Job Description:
The Business Development Manager (Lenovo) - CCA will have responsibility for driving Vendor revenue at TD SYNNEX, uncovering and closing opportunities for Vendor's products, and developing Vendor specific relationships with top TD SYNNEX customers.
Works with TD SYNNEX Latin America Sales to develop and execute business plans and marketing strategies for assigned product lines.
Works in cooperation with Inside Sales, Field Sales, Product Marketing and Vendor sales representatives and management.
Serves as TD SYNNEX's expert on the Vendor's product line.
Oversees capturing market share/mind share for Vendor and TD SYNNEX, educating sales force and customers on Vendor's technology/products and building and maintaining relationships with Vendor field sales organization.

“Let’s Achieve Great Outcomes. TD SYNNEX is the partner that helps unlock business results for all.”

What You'll Do:
- Closes specific business opportunities for Vendor's products.

- Drives sales goals/rebates/milestones through sales organization and direct customer contact.

- Drives customer/sales mind share.

- Acts as information/data source for customer/sales.

- Acts as resource for bids and special sales circumstances and facilitates any / all vendor "meet comp" programs.

- Works with TD SYNNEX Latin America sales division to develop and execute business plans and marketing strategies for designated vendors' product lines.

- Serves as interface with customer/prospect base regarding vendor's product line and remains available to meet with customers from Latin America at TD office in Miami or travel within the Latin America region to actively promote and sell the product line to meet assigned quarterly sales quotas.

- Works actively with LA Sales to promote, educate and assist in closing opportunities with vendor's product line and programs.

- Plans and executes vendor meeting presentations and assists LA team on any vendor related activities.

- Provides responsive, courteous support to sales, vendor partners and other departments at multiple management levels.

- Works with TD Territory Managers on joint sales calls, local reseller seminars, local user group meeting, etc. to promote vendor's product line. Attends training provided by vendors to ensure level of knowledge of the products required to perform presentations, training and demonstrations to customers and prospects on such products.

- Plans and executes presentations/product demonstrations of vendor's product lines at trade shows, road shows, and seminars throughout the Latin America region. Serves as an active interface between TD SYNNEX Latin America Sales and Clearwater-based product management team. Works with Clearwater-based Product Marketing and the vendor to develop reseller and sales programs specific to Latin America.

- Works actively with vendors and Marketing Services to develop comprehensive advertising and sales incentive programs supported by vendor co-op funding, which results in product line growth and enhanced profitability.

- Monitors inventory levels and reports any discrepancies to Clearwater Product Marketing department. Keeps track of co-op accruals and maximize utilization to prevent roll off.

- Tracks vendor rebate performance and communicates relevant facts to management and sales.

- Responsible for supporting our subsidiary offices as it relates to product/vendor information.

- Responsible for conducting a specific number of daily outbound calls to reseller base as determined by management Demonstrates effective utilization of available corporate resources to maximize opportunities within the territory and overall business Assists LA team on any vendor-related activities or issues.

- Performs additional duties as assigned.

- Meets attendance and punctuality standards.

What We’re Looking For:
- High School Diploma or equivalent experience from which comparable knowledge and job skills can be obtained.

- 3+ years of sales and/or marketing experience in Latin America Market .

- Able to build solid, effective working relationships with others.

- Able to constructively work under stress and pressure when faced with high workloads and deadlines.

- Able to create and conduct formal presentations.

- Able to exhibit a strong level of vigor, intensity, competitiveness, and endurance.

- Able to exhibit ability to be sensitive to the needs, concerns, and feelings of others.

- Able to express ideas clearly and convey necessary information.

- Able to interact effectively with all levels of management.

- Able to read, understand, and speak relevant foreign languages.

- Able to think strategically and tactically.

- Able to work independently with minimum supervision.

- Able to negotiate skillfully, promote/sell ideas persuasively, and close transactions with mutually beneficial results.

- Able to prepare/analyze appropriate reports and other business correspondence.

- Able to provide courteous, timely service when addressing customer questions and concerns.

- Possesses strong organizational and time management skills, driving tasks to completion.

- Able to use relevant computer system applications (which may include spreadsheets, word processors, databases, etc.) at an intermediate level.

- Able to maintain confidentiality of sensitive information.

Other Education / Certifications:
- College Degree in Business, IT (Engineering) or Marketing preferred.

- Industry experience preferred.

- Proficient in English (speak & understand) it’s a plus .

Working Conditions:
- Professional environment (Remote)

jobs.title: Ethics & Compliance Lead, APJ
jobs.description:
Job Purpose:

The Ethics & Compliance Lead, APJ , is responsible for the overall implementation, management and continuous improvement of TD SYNNEX’s ethics and compliance program (“the Program”) in the designated region;   assesses compliance risks and needs; develops and implements compliance policies and processes; develops and delivers compliance training; monitors compliance processes; conducts ethics and compliance reviews and investigations; provides guidance to business teams on compliance-related matters; promotes a strong ethics and compliance culture; supports and implements global compliance initiatives in the designated region; and contributes to the further development of the Program; responsible for assisting the Chief Ethics and Compliance Officer (“CECO”) with monitoring compliance with these requirements and the development of related reporting on the effectiveness of the Program; serves in a leadership role within the company reporting to the CECO

Responsibilities:
- Provide strategic leadership in the development and deployment of the Program in the designated region.

- Maintains and updates TD SYNNEX ’s Global Code of Conduct and related Company policies and procedures to ensure currency and clarity and with the goal of preventing illegal or unethical conduct.

- Identifies potential areas of compliance vulnerability and risk and develops and implements associated risk mitigation programs.

- Provides guidance to employees on ethics, business conduct and compliance matters.

- Oversees, manages and further develops TD SYNNEX s Anti-Bribery and Anti-Corruption compliance program in the region, including delivery of training and communications, implementation of enhanced compliance controls, and ongoing oversight of third-party compliance controls.

- Collaborates with other corporate functions, such as the Internal Audit Department, Corporate Security, the Legal Department and Human Resources and other business units to identify, mitigate and resolve ethics and compliance matters.

- Assesses the Program or components of the Program in the region and works with local business teams to develop and implement appropriate recommendations to enhance the effectiveness of the Program.

- Serves on the designated Regional Ethics & Compliance Committee in accordance with the committee charter documents and Program requirements.

- Responds to suspected violations of the Code of Conduct and related Company policies by managing and conducting investigations of such violations and assists in determining appropriate disciplinary action or other corrective action as appropriate.

- Leads cross-functional project teams as needed to implement compliance initiatives effectively.

- Reports periodically, and as requested, to the CECO on the operation and status of the Program in the designated region.

- Supports the management of the “ TD SYNNEX Ethics Line ” to ensure that employees view the Ethics Line as an effective tool for reporting potential compliance violations or seeking guidance.

- Provides policy development and implementation consulting to other business units.

- Develops, distributes and delivers effective training in support of the Program.

- Responsible for supporting the development, implementation and maintenance of systems and Company programs to address defined compliance risk areas.

- Maintains records with respect to the compliance program.

- Actively promotes TD SYNNEX ’s Global Code of Conduct, related policies and procedures and new developments in law or regulation pertaining to compliance.

- Builds TD SYNNEX ’s external reputation relating to its commitment to a culture of compliance, maintains appropriate visibility and involvement in the region’s ethics and compliance community.

- Develops and implements communication strategy and compliance training programs to educate employees and increase employee awareness of the legal and ethical standards that apply to their jobs and ensures that such communications and training reflects the latest developments in law and business ethics.

- Designs and implements effective risk assessment methodologies and develops recommendations regarding control enhancements to mitigate risks.

- Continuously evaluates the effectiveness of the Program by measuring and monitoring compliance activity and trends, participating or arranging for periodic compliance audits and collecting employee feedback on the Program through surveys or other means.

- Assists with the development and implementation of reporting regarding training and overall Program effectiveness.

- Manages, supervises and develops Regional Ethics Advisors, Ethics Advisors and direct reports in the designated region through training, communication and other appropriate support.

Knowledge, Skills and Experience:
- Juris doctorate degree from certified educational institution required. Advanced degree such as a MBA, Accounting, Certified Fraud Examiner a strong plus

- Minimum of 8 years of experience in the implementation and management of compliance programs

- Minimum of 5 years of experience managing/supervising employees

- Familiarity with anti-corruption compliance laws and controls; experience with antitrust and data privacy compliance is a plus.

- Experience at a multi-national corporation, government, international law firm or consulting firm preferred.

- Fluency in English required.

- Proficiency in additional languages is preferred Certified Compliance and Ethics Professional (“CCEP” or “CCEP-I”) designation preferred.

- Unquestionable ethics and integrity

- Ability to determine optimal approach to solve key policy issues and implement decisions.

- Strong listening, advising and mediating skills; common sense and compassion.

- Strong time and project management skills

- Able to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Proven experience effectively researching, writing, and interpreting corporate policies to meet business requirements.

- Effective communication skills and ability to negotiate and sell ideas, concepts and innovations to executives and employees at all levels of the organization.

- Able to develop training materials to educate all levels of employees related to the Code of Conduct and related Company policies.

- Understanding of U.S. Federal Sentencing Guideline requirements related to compliance activities.

- Able to interact positively and effectively with others at various levels within the organization and outside parties.

- Possesses solid management skills.

- Able to adjust readily to change and adapt as needed.

- Able to analyze and resolve complex issues and problems in a sound and timely fashion.

- Able to assimilate research data from a variety of sources, analyze, and recommend appropriate courses of action.

- Able to coach others in the development of their skills.

- Able to constructively work under stress and pressure when faced with high workloads and deadlines.

- Able to create and conduct formal presentations.

- Able to facilitate group interactions.

- Able to identify areas of risk/concern in areas of responsibility.

- Able to identify needs and opportunities and develop action plans to address compliance risks.

- Able to prepare/analyze appropriate reports and other business correspondence.

- Able to serve as a resource to others in the resolution of complex problems and issues.

- Able to think strategically and tactically.

- Possesses strong organizational and time management skills, driving tasks to completion.

- Able to maintain and promote social, ethical, and organizational standards in conducting internal and external business activities.

- Able to maintain confidentiality of sensitive information.

jobs.title: Senior Director, HR
jobs.description:
Responsibilities :
- The Senior HR Director will collaborate closely with senior leadership to plan, facilitate, lead, direct, develop, and coordinate policies, activities, and staff to attract and retain top talent.
- The Senior HR Director will lead our HR, Staffing and Recruitment teams in day-to-day operations, driving excellence and consistency throughout the organization.
- Oversees the daily workflow of human resources departments.
- Collaborates with leaders across manufacturing sites to guide, and align with communications, culture, and workflows.
- Maintains knowledge of trends, best practices, regulatory changes, and innovative technologies in human resources, talent management, and employment law; applies this knowledge to communicate changes in policy, practice, and resources to senior leadership.

- Travels as needed to other Hyve locations.
- Performs other duties as required.

- Minimum of 7-10 years of progressive experience in HR management, with a minimum of 2 years Manufacturing preferred.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager IBM
jobs.description:
Business Development Manager - IBM

Bli en nøkkelspiller i vår IBM-virksomhet hos TD SYNNEX Norge.
TD SYNNEX søker en strategisk og proaktiv Business Development Manager (BDM) med ansvar for å drive og utvikle vår IBM-virksomhet i Norge. Du vil bli en del av et sterkt nordisk team og få en sentral rolle i å bygge relasjoner, drive vekst og maksimere forretningspotensialet innen IBM sine løsninger.

Om rollen

Som BDM for IBM vil du være ansvarlig for både strategisk utvikling og gjennomføring av vårt salgsarbeid. Du vil jobbe tett sammen med interne salgs- og markedsføringsteam, IBM sin egen organisasjon og våre viktigste partnere og kunder. Rollen krever et sterkt kommersielt tankesett, teknologiforståelse og evnen til å skape verdi i komplekse B2B-miljøer.

Dine ansvarsområder
- Utvikle og implementere en salgsstrategi for IBM sine løsninger og tjenester i det norske markedet

- Bygge og opprettholde relasjoner med partnere, kunder og IBM sitt lokale team

- Drive pipelinebygging og sikre vekst gjennom nye og eksisterende kunder

- Identifisere markedsmuligheter, lansere kampanjer og støtte go-to-market-initiativer

- Samarbeide med markedsføring og salgsorganisasjonen om leadgenerering og salgsaktiviteter

- Delta i kundemøter, forhandleraktiviteter og strategiske QBRs

- Følge opp på ytelse, utarbeide prognoser og sikre målbare resultater

- Representere TD SYNNEX og IBM på arrangementer og i nettverk

Hvem er du?
- Du har minst 3-5 års erfaring med B2B-salg eller forretningsutvikling – gjerne med erfaring fra IBM, datacenter eller IT-infrastruktur

- Du har sterke relasjonelle ferdigheter og evnen til å bygge tillit hos både kunder og leverandører

- Du er forretningsorientert, strategisk tenkende og trives i en selvstendig rolle

- Du har erfaring med å jobbe i komplekse økosystemer med flere interessenter

- Du kommuniserer flytende på både norsk og engelsk

- Du jobber strukturert, har et godt overblikk og er vant til å levere resultater

Søknad
Vi behandler søknader løpende og oppfordrer deg til å registrere din interesse så raskt som mulig.
Vil du vite mer om TD SYNNEX, kan du lese om oss på TD SYNNEX Norway 2024

Hvorfor velge TD SYNNEX?

jobs.title: Incentive Compensation Operation Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Purpose :
- The Incentive Compensation Operations Analyst role is part of the regional Accounting Operations team and is responsible for the administration of various incentive plans in the Asia Pacific and Japan (APJ) region. This role requires a strong attitude with significant partnering with other teams across the organization, including Finance (FPA, Country Finance, Accounting), APJ HR (Compensation and Benefits, HR business partners) as well as business leaders (Country General Managers, Regional Business Leads).
