Responsibilities :
- Assist in coordinating and setting up new plans every quarter or year in the incentive management tool.
- Support (or lead) payout process, including calculations, manual compensation adjustments, approval process. This process will be executed in close coordination with Finance and other teams to obtain the actual performance results and the regional Compensation and Benefits team and senior leaders on approved payout adjustments.
- Perform monthly accounting activities such as calculate month-end and quarter-end accruals, post journal entries, perform and conduct various account analyses and reconciliations, research issues and provide ad hoc deliverables for internal and external audit.

- Support all testing requirements for system enhancements.

This role requires a strong attitude with significant partnering with other teams across the organization, including Finance (FPA, Country Finance, Accounting), HR (Compensation and Benefits, HR business partners) as well as business leaders (Country General Managers, Regional Business Leads). This process will be executed in close coordination with Finance and other teams to obtain the actual performance results and the regional Compensation and Benefits team and senior leaders on approved payout adjustments.

- Performs effectively under pressure, adapting to changing priorities and high workloads.

- Learns new systems and technologies quickly; adapts to evolving processes and tools.

Working Conditions:
- Professional, office environment.

- Occasional non-standard work hours or overtime as business requires.

- Hybrid work model: 3 days in-office, 2 days remote per week. Flexibility may vary based on business needs and changes.

jobs.title: Regulatory Compliance Manager
jobs.description:
Job Purpose:

Position Summary
The Manager, Regulatory Compliance APJ is responsible for leading and supporting export compliance activities across the Asia Pacific region with India being a key focus market. This role will be based in India and ideally in Mumbai and will provides day-to-day guidance on export control matters, manages compliance escalations, implements trade compliance programs, and ensures adherence to applicable export regulations and internal policies.
The position serves as a key business partner to Sales, Operations, Logistics, Customs Brokers, and other stakeholders, while also supporting regulatory compliance initiatives, audits, training programs, and government inquiries. A strong understanding of U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), India export controls, and regional export control regulations, requirements and processes is essential.
This role requires an in-office presence of at least three days per week.

Responsibilities:
Export Compliance Operations
- Manage and resolve daily export control escalations raised by Sales, Sales Operations, Logistics, Customs Brokers, and other business stakeholders.
- Provide guidance on export licensing, classification, screening requirements, and regulatory obligations across the Asia Pacific region.
- Support business transactions by evaluating export control and trade compliance risks and recommending appropriate mitigation measures.

Compliance Program Management
- Implement and maintain the company's global export compliance program across multiple countries within the APJ region.
- Champion compliance with applicable export control laws, regulations, and corporate policies.
- Monitor and assess regulatory developments and support implementation of compliance requirements to meet evolving regulatory developments.

Training and Awareness
- Aid in design and deliver of training programs for Co-workers and stakeholders on trade compliance topics
- Promote a culture of compliance through ongoing education and stakeholder engagement.

Job Description:
The Business Development Manager (HPE – SPs & Telcos) for the CCA (Caribbean Central America) organization identifies business expansion opportunities that support the customer sales strategy.

“Let’s achieve great outcomes. TD SYNNEX helps partners unlock business results for all.”

- Present solution and service offerings, including TaaS, to key customers.

- Drive sales across the agreed vendor portfolio, including identifying and onboarding new vendors and leading business development initiatives to optimize results.

- Lead sales for specific vendors or projects when specialized account knowledge is required.

- Enable sales teams to win opportunities and grow wallet share and market share.

- Negotiate successfully and win key tenders and large deals.

- Build strong vendor and stakeholder relationships so Tech Data is viewed as a trusted advisor.

- Increase customer loyalty and profitability.

- Collaborate with FSE and vendor teams.

- Support the development of direct reports and/or divisional Business Development Executives (BDEs).

- Maintain full knowledge of the assigned product or service line.

- Engage with key customers.

jobs.title: Business Development Executive, Advanced Solutions (H/F/X)
jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous ?
Maillon essentiel dans le marché de la distribution IT en BtoB, notre assurons la commercialisation, auprès des revendeurs IT, de matériels et solutions proposés par nos fournisseurs.
Nous apportons savoir-faire et expertise à l’ensemble de nos partenaires afin de les soutenir dans leur développement commercial et stratégique.
Chez TD SYNNEX, nous valorisons la diversité, les différences et le travail collectif.

Rejoignez la Business Unit, Advanced Solutions qui permet à ses partenaires de proposer des solutions informatiques complexes dans le monde entier. Grâce à notre approche innovante, s'appuyant sur une solide expérience des data centers, logiciels, technologies cloud, infrastructures convergées et hyperconvergées, de l'analytique, de la sécurité et de l'IoT, nos partenaires sont en mesure d'offrir à leurs clients les solutions complètes qui les accompagneront dans leur évolution en leur garantissant une compétitivité durable.
Une équipe impatiente de vous accueillir. La belle dynamique de cette Team est insufflée par Eric Herlin, votre futur Manager.

Ce que vous ferez - Vous serez le contact commercial privilégié de nos clients grâce à une relation solide basée sur la confiance afin de soutenir la croissance de notre part de marché à travers la mise en œuvre de la stratégie commerciale et du pipeline.

En quoi cela consiste exactement ?
Vous animez un réseau de partenaire pour plusieurs marques, afin de développer le chiffre d'affaires.

Vos missions, si vous les acceptez, seront :
Formez et accompagnez : Partagez votre expertise en formant les équipes commerciales internes et les clients sur la marque « XXX », tout en renforçant leur notoriété.
Boostez la croissance : Concevez et déployez des stratégies innovantes pour favoriser le développement de l’activité et identifier de nouvelles opportunités commerciales. Vous répondrez aux appels d’offres et communiquez les informations sur les produits, les prix, les offres spéciales et les promotions aux clients et aux équipes de vente internes.
Pilotez la performance : Assurez un suivi précis dans le CRM de la société (Compass) et un reporting hebdomadaire auprès des fournisseurs. Mesurez et soutenez l’impact des actions commerciales et marketing mises en place. Suivez les performances des activités promotionnelles et du pipeline.
Collaborez : Travaillez main dans la main avec les équipes commerciales et marketing, point de contact clé pour maximiser la satisfaction client et développer le business.
Adoptez une approche digitale : Simplifiez l’expérience client en favorisant l’utilisation de nos services et outils digitaux. Contribuez au développement et à la maintenance des outils Web tels que InTouch, Licensing Online ainsi que les microsites des fournisseurs.

Votre profil,
Vous avez une expérience de 2-3 ans dans :
- Le développement commercial et la gestion d’un portefeuille clients, idéalement dans le secteur IT.

Job Description:
The Cybersecurity Automation & Continuous Compliance Analyst supports TD SYNNEX's continuous compliance program through automation, AI, integrations, and data-driven control monitoring.
This role focuses on building automated solutions that improve visibility into cybersecurity controls protecting critical business operations.
The successful candidate will leverage APIs, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), AI technologies, and workflow automation to reduce manual compliance activities, improve reporting, and enable continuous monitoring of security controls.
This position is ideal for a technically focused professional with experience in cloud platforms, automation, integrations, and cybersecurity.

“Let’s Achieve Great Outcomes. TD SYNNEX is the partner that helps unlock business results for all.”

- Build automated solutions that collect, validate, and report on cybersecurity control effectiveness.

- Utilize APIs, workflow automation tools, and AI capabilities to reduce manual compliance activities.

- Support implementation of continuous control monitoring across critical business and technology environments.

- Assist with development of dashboards, metrics, and reporting that provide visibility into cybersecurity risk and control performance.

- Review cloud and Infrastructure as Code deployments for alignment with cybersecurity requirements.

- Work with engineering and cybersecurity teams to identify opportunities for automation and operational efficiency.

- Support the organization's revenue-focused risk management and continuous compliance strategy.

- Performs other additional duties as assigned.

- Experience developing integrations using APIs and web services.

- Experience with scripting and automation using Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, or similar technologies.

- Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

- Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Terraform, Bicep, ARM Templates, or CloudFormation.

- Understanding of cybersecurity controls and risk management concepts.

- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

- Increase automation of cybersecurity compliance activities.

- Reduce manual reporting and evidence collection efforts.

- Leverage AI and automation technologies to improve efficiency and decision-making.

- Experience with AI-powered automation tools, copilots, agents, large language models (LLMs), or workflow orchestration platforms.

jobs.title: Procurement Analyst / Analyste en approvisionnement
jobs.description:
About the Role
Are you passionate about supply chain optimization, inventory management, and driving business performance through strategic procurement decisions? As a Procurement Analyst , you will play a critical role in supporting TD SYNNEX's stocking and drop ship procurement operations while helping maximize revenue, profitability, and customer satisfaction.
In this role, you will collaborate closely with Product Management, Sales, Vendors, and Operations teams to ensure inventory investments are optimized, risks are minimized, and procurement strategies align with business objectives. You will have the opportunity to influence key inventory decisions, improve processes, strengthen vendor partnerships, and contribute directly to the company's financial success.
If you enjoy analyzing data, solving complex challenges, negotiating favorable outcomes, and making a measurable impact across the supply chain, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do
Inventory Management & Optimization
- Analyze inventory trends and performance metrics to support revenue and profitability goals.
- Manage inventory levels to achieve departmental objectives related to on-hand inventory, days of supply, inventory turns, and aged stock.
- Partner with Product Management to develop action plans that mitigate inventory risks, address excess inventory, and resolve supply constraints.
- Minimize financial exposure related to low-turn products, aging inventory, excess stock, and price protection claims.

Procurement & Vendor Management
- Evaluate and recommend strategic purchasing opportunities that maximize business value and financial returns.
- Collaborate with vendors and internal stakeholders to support procurement initiatives and inventory planning strategies.
- Negotiate exceptional return agreements and other vendor accommodations to address excess inventory and business needs.
- Ensure compliance with vendor terms and conditions to reduce organizational risk.
- Recommend and implement improvements based on vendor scorecard reviews and performance analysis.

Operational Excellence
- Manage drop ship billing activities to ensure timely and accurate revenue recognition.
- Resolve purchase order disputes, shipment discrepancies, and vendor-related issues with minimal business impact.
- Support Sales, Product Management, and Operations teams as a key escalation point for inventory and procurement matters.
- Participate in Sales, Inventory, and Operations Planning (SIOP) reviews and inventory forecasting activities.
- Assist with User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for system enhancements and contribute to onboarding and training of new team members.

What We're Looking For
Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations, Finance, or a related field.
- 3 to 5 years of experience in inventory management, procurement, supply chain operations, purchasing, or a related discipline.
- Experience analyzing data, identifying trends, and making recommendations that drive business outcomes.
- Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and data analysis tools.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Skills
- Inventory planning and forecasting experience.
- Vendor management and negotiation experience.
- Understanding of supply chain, procurement, and inventory control principles.
- Experience working in a fast-paced distribution, technology, manufacturing, or logistics environment.

Key Competencies
- Critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
- Strong analytical and decision-making abilities.
- Attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
- Strong organizational and time management skills.
- Adaptability and willingness to embrace change.
- Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.
- Relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.
- High level of professionalism, integrity, and confidentiality.
- Ability to quickly learn new systems, tools, and processes.

Why Join TD SYNNEX?
At TD SYNNEX, you'll be part of a global technology solutions leader where innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning drive our success.
We offer:
- Opportunities to make a meaningful impact on company performance and operational excellence.
- Exposure to cross-functional leadership teams and vendor partners.
- Professional development and career growth opportunities within supply chain, procurement, product management, and operations.
- A collaborative and inclusive culture built on our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Integrity, Excellence, and Inclusion.
- Flexible remote work environment that supports work-life balance.

Working Conditions
- Remote / work-from-home environment.
- Professional office setting when required.
- Occasional non-standard work hours or overtime based on business needs.

Pay Transparency
TD SYNNEX is committed to providing fair and competitive compensation.
Actual compensation is based on skills, experience, and location.
- Starting salary: $63,900 CAD+

Actual compensation may vary based on factors including geographic location, skills, experience, certifications, internal equity, and business considerations. In addition to base compensation, eligible employees may participate in incentive programs, bonus opportunities, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Analyste en approvisionnement

À propos du poste
Êtes-vous passionné(e) par l’optimisation de la chaîne d’approvisionnement, la gestion des stocks et l’amélioration de la performance des affaires grâce à des décisions stratégiques en approvisionnement? À titre d’ Analyste en approvisionnement , vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans le soutien des opérations d’approvisionnement liées aux stocks et aux expéditions directes (drop ship) de TD SYNNEX, tout en contribuant à maximiser les revenus, la rentabilité et la satisfaction de la clientèle.
Dans ce rôle, vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes de gestion de produits, des ventes, des fournisseurs et des opérations afin d’optimiser les investissements en stocks, de réduire les risques et d’assurer l’alignement des stratégies d’approvisionnement avec les objectifs d’affaires. Vous aurez l’occasion d’influencer des décisions clés en matière d’inventaire, d’améliorer les processus, de renforcer les partenariats fournisseurs et de contribuer directement au succès financier de l’entreprise.
Si vous aimez analyser des données, résoudre des problèmes complexes, négocier des solutions avantageuses et avoir un impact mesurable sur la chaîne d’approvisionnement, nous aimerions vous rencontrer.

Ce que vous ferez
Gestion et optimisation des stocks
- Analyser les tendances d’inventaire et les indicateurs de performance afin de soutenir les objectifs de revenus et de rentabilité.
- Gérer les niveaux de stocks pour atteindre les objectifs du département en matière d’inventaire disponible, de jours d’approvisionnement, de rotation des stocks et de gestion des stocks vieillissants.
- Collaborer avec l’équipe de gestion de produits pour élaborer des plans d’action visant à réduire les risques liés aux stocks, à gérer les surplus et à résoudre les contraintes d’approvisionnement.
- Réduire l’exposition financière liée aux produits à faible rotation, aux stocks vieillissants, aux surplus d’inventaire et aux réclamations de protection des prix.

Approvisionnement et gestion des fournisseurs
- Évaluer et recommander des occasions d’achat stratégiques permettant de maximiser la valeur commerciale et les rendements financiers.
- Collaborer avec les fournisseurs et les parties prenantes internes afin de soutenir les initiatives d’approvisionnement et les stratégies de planification des stocks.
- Négocier des ententes de retour exceptionnelles et d’autres accommodements avec les fournisseurs afin de gérer les surplus d’inventaire et répondre aux besoins de l’entreprise.
- Veiller au respect des modalités et conditions des fournisseurs afin de réduire les risques organisationnels.
- Recommander et mettre en œuvre des améliorations à partir des évaluations des fournisseurs et des analyses de performance.

Excellence opérationnelle
- Gérer les activités de facturation liées aux expéditions directes afin d’assurer une comptabilisation des revenus exacte et en temps opportun.
- Résoudre les litiges relatifs aux bons de commande, les écarts d’expédition et les problèmes liés aux fournisseurs en minimisant l’impact sur les activités.
- Soutenir les équipes des ventes, de la gestion de produits et des opérations à titre de personne-ressource principale pour les enjeux liés aux stocks et à l’approvisionnement.

jobs.description:
About the Role [Finance] :

The Financial Analyst analyzes and interprets financial and operating data for business planning and operations management.  This position is accountable for providing accurately and timely pre-defined financial reports and detailed analysis on business performance.  This role is critical for functional departmental objectives to be met such as forecasting accuracy, functional organizational goals, other internal metrics, etc.  This role requires close interaction with peers within Finance (FP&A, SG&A, Accounting) as well as functional business leaders.

The Financial Analyst [Accounting] analyzes and interprets financial and operating data for business planning and operations management. This position is accountable for providing accurately and timely pre-defined financial reports and detailed analysis on business performance. This role is critical for functional departmental objectives to be met such as forecasting accuracy, functional organizational goals, other internal metrics, etc. This role requires close interaction with peers within Finance (FP&A, SG&A, Accounting) as well as functional business leaders. Completes complex accounting analyses while partnering with customer/vendor/internal owners. Identifies, researches, and resolves items impacting the accounting treatment of financial statements. Monthly and quarterly accounting processes supporting various departments. Review and guide associate analysts.

Job Purpose:

This position will be the point-of-contact for Sales Operations and vendors. They will also play an integral role working with Sales, Products, Finance, Trade Compliance, Enterprise Data Management and other Cross Functional Departments. The Procurement Specialist is required to primarily manage all purchasing activities between TD SYNNEX and vendors, so as to ensure the effective procurement and fulfillment of products and services to customer in a timely manner.  This is an individual contributor position.

Responsibilities:
- Develop an in-depth knowledge of TD SYNNEX core business model and processes, acquire an understanding of IT product attributes and vendor requirements in order to successfully place accurate sales order to the procurement department.

- Be knowledgeable of business initiatives, key processes and guidelines, internal resources and vendor requirements in order to assist sales in accomplishing company goals.

- Follow guidelines. Ensure that business is conducted with highest level of compliance and integrity at all times and behavior aligns with TD SYNNEX values.

- Process high volume orders with high level of accuracy and efficiency.

- Be flexible and committed to support business needs at all times.

- Serve as the main point of contact for sales personnel and coordinate with finance, trade compliance, procurement and management team

- Review purchase requisitions submitted by sales operations in SAP. Validate and ensure complete and accurate order details are provided. Convert PR to PO, and submit PO on to vendor.

- Owning the order process and provide updates at key stages to the sales and product managers in a timely manner.

- Place new stocking purchase orders on vendors as requested by product managers or inventory managers, where applicable.

- Review purchase order backlogs regularly, update vendor delivery dates, follow up on past dues and advise sales and sales operations on order status as required.

- Process drop ship orders and/or delivery confirmation as soon as notifications of delivery are provided by the vendor.

- Perform inbound in TD SYNNEX system for software licenses, services and other non-tangible items. Complete the necessary administrative confirmation to vendor and submit relevant supporting document to TD SYNNEX support team for invoicing customer.

- Manage rejected orders by liaising with sales and sales operations to make necessary corrections and order resubmission.

- Support finance in resolving queries they raise with vendor invoices and credit notes.

- Process stock returns to vendors, stock rotations and stock transfers.

- Proper review and ensure compliance to Purchasing and Global Trade Compliance guidelines.

- Close liaison with the sales and product managers to ensure customer expectations are met and/or exceeded and principal vendor order submission timelines are achieved.

- Identify and document updates on new vendor line card processes, on need basis.

- Understand all processes which the vendors operate and be fully competent with the use of vendor ordering tools i.e. portals, EDI  and any other related systems.

- Understand TD SYNNEX internal processes, both business and systems related, and full adherence to trade compliance requirements.

- Assisting the Business Units with any ad hoc requests on orders, returns and inquiries.

- Meeting and exceed predefined service level agreements (SLA) and individual KPIs.

- Outlook – Believes in self, company and marketplace and is passionate about learning and growing. Takes responsibility for own success, accepts challenges, does not take “no” as failure, but as an opportunity to succeed.

- Learn – Able to pick up new things about Systems and on the job in a short period of time. Takes initiative with minimum supervision.

- Communication – demonstrates and promotes positive prospect, client, and work relationships; proactively addresses and manages conflict and disputes; works to achieve constructive resolution.

- Oral Communication - Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; listens and gets clarification; responds well to questions.

- Written Communication - Writes clearly, informatively and accurately with appropriate  writing style to meet needs; presents numerical data effectively; able to read, interpret and comprehend written information.

- Character - Demonstrates unquestionable integrity in every aspect of work and dealing with others; consistently models desired behaviors and values established by the company; respects diversity of perspective in discussions; desire to learn, take challenges and demonstrates concerns to deliver a high standard of job quality.

- Business Acumen – Mature personality, knows what to say or do at the appropriate time, is cool under pressure and is prepared for whatever the stakeholder or customer does or says.

- Results Orientation – Makes fact based decisions, multi-tasks and follows through to completion, analyses and uses data to achieve sales goals, drives execution, initiates action and follow-ups to successful completion.

- Collaboration and Team Player - Effectively builds and maintains partnerships with sales, stakeholders and team members at all levels across the company.

Knowledge, Skills and Experience:
- Diploma/Degree/Professional qualification in Business, Finance or other related field or equivalent work experience.

- Minimum of 2 years relevant working experience, ideally in IT multinational environment.

- At the minimum 3 years of solid work related experience, if does not possess a degree.

- Track record on Sales/Procurement Operations with SAP and/or ERP systems experience is an added advantage.

- Shared services experience and/or able to work shift would also be an added advantage.

About the Role
The Procurement Specialist supports procurement, order management, inventory, and billing activities for TD SYNNEX's federal business. This role is responsible for executing purchasing transactions, maintaining accurate documentation, resolving order issues, and supporting vendor relationships while helping ensure operational efficiency, compliance, and profitability.

- Process timely and accurate billing activities to support revenue recognition requirements.
- Serve as a point of escalation for vendors, customers, and internal stakeholders, driving issues to resolution and communicating outcomes effectively.
- Conduct return authorization and stock rotation analysis to minimize inventory risk.

- Assist with onboarding and knowledge transfer activities for new team members.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager - Cyber Security
jobs.description:
Proč se přidat k TD SYNNEX

Staňte se součástí společnosti TD SYNNEX , jednoho z předních světových distributorů IT technologií, a pomozte nám rozvíjet oblast kybernetické bezpečnosti na českém trhu. Hledáme zkušeného obchodníka, který bude rozvíjet naše security portfolio, budovat vztahy s partnery a vytvářet nové obchodní příležitosti. Budete spolupracovat s předními technologickými výrobci, jako jsou Palo Alto Networks, SonicWall, Cisco, Microsoft, HPE, HCL a další, a stanete se důležitou součástí našeho úspěšného Security týmu.

O pozici

Jako Business Development Manager pro oblast kybernetické bezpečnosti budete zodpovědní za rozvoj obchodních aktivit, podporu partnerské sítě a růst security businessu v České republice. Vaší rolí bude propojovat partnery, výrobce a interní týmy tak, aby společně dosahovali obchodních úspěchů.

- Zkušenosti na obchodní pozici v oblasti IT, ideálně se zaměřením na kybernetickou bezpečnost
- Orientaci v oblasti cybersecurity a přehled o aktuálních trendech

TD SYNNEX ist ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen in der IT-Distribution. Wir bringen Technologiehersteller mit Vertriebspartnern (vom Fachhändler über Retailer bis hin zu Corporate-B2B-Partnern und IT-Spezialisten) zusammen und sorgen dafür, dass moderne IT-Lösungen erfolgreich eingesetzt werden – von Hardware und Software bis zu Cloud-, AI- und Serviceangeboten.
Mit rund 23.000 Mitarbeitenden, mehr als 150.000 Kunden und über 2.500 Technologiepartnern sind wir in über 100 Ländern aktiv. Unser globales Headquarter befindet sich in den USA, mit starken regionalen Teams – auch in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz.
Die IT-Branche zählt zu den dynamischsten überhaupt. Bei TD SYNNEX bedeutet das: tägliche Abwechslung, neue Herausforderungen und die Möglichkeit, aktiv an der digitalen Zukunft mitzuwirken.
